body: Added relationGraph(project, {root, limit}) in src/relation-graph.js: all relation types, layers by blocks chains (Kahn queue), rows by ticket number, limit with truncated, hidden count. Wired into src/index.js (p.relationGraph), src/index.d.ts (GraphNode, GraphEdge, RelationGraphResult), GET /api/roadmap/graph in src/server.js and plantool graph [--root ID] [--limit N] [--format json] in bin/plantool.js. Layers are computed before the limit cut; the reported layers count uses the nodes that are returned.
